replacement.title: Removable Spouts
replacement.definition: The dispensing spouts must detach easily to support cleaning and servicing without changing their independently specified geometry.

patches.decision_note: Spout removal is independently requested and can change without changing spout geometry, valve behavior, or general fluid-path sanitation.

replacement.title: Engineering Documentation Archive
replacement.definition: The project documentation, including materials records, CAD files, BOM, wiring information, cleaning guidance, and available exploded views, should be retained for future use.

patches.decision_note: Retention of the engineering documentation set is an independently requested artifact rather than part of creating any single CAD, BOM, or wiring deliverable.

The K-marked dispense buttons remain a possible current-prototype detail while silver DJ controls, measurement markings, and other cosmetic control refinements move to later work, demonstrating independent lifecycles.
The source asks about the load from both motors but does not establish two independently controlled stations or simultaneous station operation.
The requested several-minute demonstration is a testing instruction, not a client change to the product's dual-station behavior.
Adding an enclosure slot is only an incidental fabrication step and does not claim that the functional main power interface was implemented.
The source claims hidden routing and general serviceability but does not claim that the fluid path is sanitary, cleanable, flushable, or free of liquid traps.
The source postpones additional cosmetic refinement generally but does not defer or reverse the established beige-and-green color scheme.

Earlier evidence likely establishes the dual independent mixing-station Requirement, but the necessary raw proposal text is not included here to construct a target-entailing replacement INTRODUCE Event safely.

The extraction findings identify a successful motor spin test that may be missing execution evidence for the variable-speed motor drive, but the raw source text is unavailable for safe classification and verbatim addition.

These messages may provide a post-repair no-leak result, but their raw text is needed to distinguish a runtime verification from a repeated implementation claim and to retain only the minimal post-fix transition.
